project.name: Maze: Identity
project.core_idea: Identity is not about escaping the path, but understanding how it shapes who we become.

scenes.name: School Maze
scenes.description: A guided corridor maze representing early structured identity formation.

scenes.name: Examination Hall
scenes.description: A quantified space where identity is measured and compared.

scenes.name: Lost Place
scenes.description: An unstructured maze with minimal guidance and increased ambiguity.

scenes.name: Center
scenes.description: A central convergence space symbolizing visibility and success.

scenes.name: Inversion
scenes.description: The examination world flips into a vertical city structure.

scenes.name: Ascent
scenes.description: A prolonged climb emphasizing effort without guaranteed freedom.

scenes.name: Summit
scenes.description: A non-playable ending space where the path remains but no longer defines the player.

known_issues.title: Animation reload after returning from Options menu
known_issues.description: Opening the Options menu during gameplay and returning to the game may cause certain scene animations to reload.

ui.notes: Core navigation and settings functional; minor transition issues remain.

checkpoint.notes: Progress checkpoints validated across all scenes.

scene_transition.notes: Unified trigger-based transition system in use.

other_platforms.notes: Public downloads will be handled via dedicated distribution platforms.
